d: The Congress party has taken disciplinary action against 60 leaders who reportedly remained absent from Rahul Gandhi’s rally in Delhi. The Madhya Pradesh Congress has suspended these leaders, raising questions about internal discipline and political coordination within the party. The action comes amid efforts by the Congress leadership to strengthen its organisation and ensure greater participation in important political programmes. Why did these leaders skip the rally?
